name: Viral DNA base ratios
summary: Wyatt found that DNA from eleven insect viruses had nearly equal A and T and equal G and C despite varying overall make-up, evidence Watson and Crick later cited.
description: Wyatt’s analyses of DNA from 11 insect viruses found A:T and G:C near unity while aggregate base composition varied.
tier_reason: Retain the modest result tier. The original model really cites Wyatt; calling it the wrong witness confuses a missing Chargaff entry with a false identity. This is a scoped consequence judgement, not a reward for documentation or representation.
